mapper.select: SELECT S.SUIT_ID AS suitId, S.FIRST_SUIT_ID AS firstSuitId, S.CASE_KIND_CD AS caseKindCd, CK.CODE_NM AS caseKindNm, S.INSTANCE_CD AS instanceCd, IC.CODE_NM AS instanceNm, S.COURT_ID AS courtId, S.COURT_NM AS courtNm, S.CASE_YEAR AS caseYear, S.CASE_SIGN_CD AS caseSignCd, S.CASE_SERIAL AS caseSerial, S.CASE_NO AS caseNo, S.CASE_NM_CD AS caseNmCd, S.CASE_NM AS caseNm, S.CIVIL_CASE_CD AS civilCaseCd, CC.CODE_NM AS civilCaseNm, S.ITPT_KIND_CD AS itptKindCd, IT.CODE_NM AS itptKindNm, S.SUIT_AMT AS suitAmt, S.OFFICE_RECEIPT_DT AS officeReceiptDt, S.FR_DT AS frDt, S.STC_DT AS stcDt, S.DCSN_DT AS dcsnDt, S.RSLT_KIND_CD AS rsltKindCd, S.RSLT_KIND_NM AS rsltKindNm, NVL(S.RSLT_KIND_NM, RS.CODE_NM) AS rsltDispNm, S.WIN_AMT AS winAmt, S.LOSE_AMT AS loseAmt, S.LOSS_CAUSE_CD AS lossCauseCd, LC.CODE_NM AS lossCauseNm, S.MERGE_CASE AS mergeCase, S.COST_FIX_DT AS costFixDt, S.COST_FIX_AMT AS costFixAmt, S.COST_RCV_AMT AS costRcvAmt, S.RETAINER_AMT AS retainerAmt, S.SUCCESS_AMT AS successAmt, S.SPECIAL_DESC AS specialDesc, S.DEL_YN AS delYn, S.REG_USER_ID AS regUserId, S.REG_DT AS regDt, S.UPD_USER_ID AS updUserId, S.UPD_DT AS updDt FROM LAW_SUIT S LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE CK ON CK.CODE_ID = 'LAW_CASE_KIND' AND CK.CODE = S.CASE_KIND_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE IC ON IC.CODE_ID = 'LAW_INSTANCE' AND IC.CODE = S.INSTANCE_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE RS ON RS.CODE_ID = 'LAW_RESULT' AND RS.CODE = S.RSLT_KIND_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE CC ON CC.CODE_ID = 'LAW_CIVIL_CASE' AND CC.CODE = S.CIVIL_CASE_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE IT ON IT.CODE_ID = 'LAW_ITPT_KIND' AND IT.CODE = S.ITPT_KIND_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE LC ON LC.CODE_ID = 'LAW_LOSS_CAUSE' AND LC.CODE = S.LOSS_CAUSE_CD WHERE S.SUIT_ID = #{suitId} AND S.DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LAW_SUIT ( SUIT_ID, FIRST_SUIT_ID, CASE_KIND_CD, INSTANCE_CD, COURT_ID, COURT_NM, CASE_YEAR, CASE_SIGN_CD, CASE_SERIAL, CASE_NO, CASE_NM_CD, CASE_NM, CIVIL_CASE_CD, ITPT_KIND_CD, SUIT_AMT, OFFICE_RECEIPT_DT, FR_DT, STC_DT, DCSN_DT, RSLT_KIND_CD, RSLT_KIND_NM, WIN_AMT, LOSE_AMT, LOSS_CAUSE_CD, MERGE_CASE, COST_FIX_DT, COST_FIX_AMT, COST_RCV_AMT, RETAINER_AMT, SUCCESS_AMT, SPECIAL_DESC, DEL_YN, REG_USER_ID, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{suitId}, #{firstSuitId}, #{caseKindCd}, #{instanceCd}, #{courtId}, #{courtNm}, #{caseYear}, #{caseSignCd}, #{caseSerial}, #{caseNo}, #{caseNmCd}, #{caseNm}, #{civilCaseCd}, #{itptKindCd}, #{suitAmt}, #{officeReceiptDt}, #{frDt}, #{stcDt}, #{dcsnDt}, #{rsltKindCd}, #{rsltKindNm}, #{winAmt}, #{loseAmt}, #{lossCauseCd}, #{mergeCase}, #{costFixDt}, #{costFixAmt}, #{costRcvAmt}, #{retainerAmt}, #{successAmt}, #{specialDesc}, 'N', #{regUserId}, #{regDt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE LAW_SUIT SET CASE_KIND_CD = #{caseKindCd}, INSTANCE_CD = #{instanceCd}, COURT_ID = #{courtId}, COURT_NM = #{courtNm}, CASE_YEAR = #{caseYear}, CASE_SIGN_CD = #{caseSignCd}, CASE_SERIAL = #{caseSerial}, CASE_NO = #{caseNo}, CASE_NM_CD = #{caseNmCd}, CASE_NM = #{caseNm}, CIVIL_CASE_CD = #{civilCaseCd}, ITPT_KIND_CD = #{itptKindCd}, SUIT_AMT = #{suitAmt}, OFFICE_RECEIPT_DT = #{officeReceiptDt}, FR_DT = #{frDt}, STC_DT = #{stcDt}, DCSN_DT = #{dcsnDt}, RSLT_KIND_CD = #{rsltKindCd}, RSLT_KIND_NM = #{rsltKindNm}, WIN_AMT = #{winAmt}, LOSE_AMT = #{loseAmt}, LOSS_CAUSE_CD = #{lossCauseCd}, MERGE_CASE = #{mergeCase}, COST_FIX_DT = #{costFixDt}, COST_FIX_AMT = #{costFixAmt}, COST_RCV_AMT = #{costRcvAmt}, RETAINER_AMT = #{retainerAmt}, SUCCESS_AMT = #{successAmt}, SPECIAL_DESC = #{specialDesc}, UPD_USER_ID = #{updUserId}, UPD_DT = #{updDt} WHERE SUIT_ID = #{suitId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT PARTY_ID AS partyId, SUIT_ID AS suitId, PARTY_TYPE AS partyType, PARTY_NM AS partyNm, BIRTH AS birth, JUMIN_ENC AS juminEnc, AGENT_NM AS agentNm, SORT_ORDR AS sortOrdr FROM LAW_SUIT_PARTY WHERE SUIT_ID = #{suitId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN PARTY_TYPE = 'P' THEN 1 WHEN PARTY_TYPE = 'D' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, SORT_ORDR, PARTY_ID
SELECT LAND_ID AS landId, SUIT_ID AS suitId, LOCATION AS location, JIBUN AS jibun, SORT_ORDR AS sortOrdr FROM LAW_SUIT_LAND WHERE SUIT_ID = #{suitId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDR, LAND_ID

SELECT T.STAFF_ID AS staffId, T.SUIT_ID AS suitId, T.ORGNZT_ID AS orgnztId, O.ORGNZT_NM AS orgnztNm, T.STAFF_NM AS staffNm, T.ASSIGN_DT AS assignDt, T.SORT_ORDR AS sortOrdr FROM LAW_SUIT_STAFF T LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO O ON O.ORGNZT_ID = T.ORGNZT_ID WHERE T.SUIT_ID = #{suitId} ORDER BY T.SORT_ORDR, T.STAFF_ID

SELECT G.PROG_ID AS progId, G.SUIT_ID AS suitId, G.PROG_KIND_CD AS progKindCd, PK.CODE_NM AS progKindNm, G.DYPR_KIND_CD AS dyprKindCd, DK.CODE_NM AS dyprKindNm, G.PROG_DT AS progDt, G.PROG_TM AS progTm, G.PLACE AS place, G.PROG_DESC AS progDesc, G.STAT_CD AS statCd, ST.CODE_NM AS statNm, G.RESULT_DESC AS resultDesc FROM LAW_SUIT_PROG G LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE PK ON PK.CODE_ID = 'LAW_PROG_KIND' AND PK.CODE = G.PROG_KIND_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE DK ON DK.CODE_ID = 'LAW_DYPR_KIND' AND DK.CODE = G.DYPR_KIND_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE ST ON ST.CODE_ID = 'LAW_PROG_STAT' AND ST.CODE = G.STAT_CD WHERE G.SUIT_ID = #{suitId} ORDER BY G.PROG_DT, G.PROG_TM, G.PROG_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LAW_SUIT_PROG ( PROG_ID, SUIT_ID, PROG_KIND_CD, DYPR_KIND_CD, PROG_DT, PROG_TM, PLACE, PROG_DESC, STAT_CD, RESULT_DESC, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{progId}, #{suitId}, #{progKindCd}, #{dyprKindCd}, #{progDt}, #{progTm}, #{place}, #{progDesc}, #{statCd}, #{resultDesc}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') )
mapper.select: SELECT H.HIST_ID AS histId, H.SUIT_ID AS suitId, H.HIST_SEQ AS histSeq, H.RSLT_KIND_CD AS rsltKindCd, H.RSLT_KIND_NM AS rsltKindNm, NVL(H.RSLT_KIND_NM, RS.CODE_NM) AS rsltDispNm, H.END_DT AS endDt, H.HIST_DESC AS histDesc, H.REG_USER_ID AS regUserId, H.REG_DT AS regDt FROM LAW_SUIT_RSLT_HIST H LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE RS ON RS.CODE_ID = 'LAW_RESULT' AND RS.CODE = H.RSLT_KIND_CD WHERE H.SUIT_ID = #{suitId} ORDER BY H.HIST_SEQ DESC

SELECT S.SUIT_ID AS suitId, S.INSTANCE_CD AS instanceCd, IC.CODE_NM AS instanceNm, S.COURT_NM AS courtNm, S.CASE_NO AS caseNo, S.CASE_NM AS caseNm, S.FR_DT AS frDt, S.STC_DT AS stcDt, NVL(S.RSLT_KIND_NM, RS.CODE_NM) AS rsltDispNm FROM LAW_SUIT S LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE IC ON IC.CODE_ID = 'LAW_INSTANCE' AND IC.CODE = S.INSTANCE_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE RS ON RS.CODE_ID = 'LAW_RESULT' AND RS.CODE = S.RSLT_KIND_CD WHERE S.FIRST_SUIT_ID = #{firstSuitId} AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY S.SUIT_ID

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT S.SUIT_ID AS suitId, S.FIRST_SUIT_ID AS firstSuitId, S.CASE_KIND_CD AS caseKindCd, S.INSTANCE_CD AS instanceCd, IC.CODE_NM AS instanceNm, S.COURT_ID AS courtId, S.COURT_NM AS courtNm, S.CASE_NO AS caseNo, S.CASE_NM_CD AS caseNmCd, S.CASE_NM AS caseNm, S.CIVIL_CASE_CD AS civilCaseCd, S.ITPT_KIND_CD AS itptKindCd, S.SUIT_AMT AS suitAmt FROM LAW_SUIT S LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE IC ON IC.CODE_ID = 'LAW_INSTANCE' AND IC.CODE = S.INSTANCE_CD WHERE S.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND (S.CASE_NO LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR S.CASE_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY S.SUIT_ID DESC ) X LIMIT 20
